answer_1.quote: In this paper, we address the challenge of minimizing misgendering across 42 languages and dialects within an AI-based application... test them in a meeting transcript summarization context.

answer_2.quote: We establish two metrics to identify instances of misgendering, along with one quality metric to assess whether the language-specific guardrails adversely impact the output quality. Gender Mistake (GM): Binary metric... Gender Assumption (GA): Binary metric... Quality (Q): A ternary metric between 0-2...

answer_3.quote: For LLM-based evaluation, we use GPT-4o, Phi-3.5-MoE-Instruct and Qwen-25-vl7b as judges... We prompt the LLM with metrics and rubrics describing each metric.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation was done by three native speakers per language. They were requested to evaluate the model's output with the same metrics (GM, GA, Q) from Section 4.3.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the model's output with the same metrics (GM, GA, Q)
